title: Call and response and the black contribution
summary: Perhanis suggests Buddy Bolden drew on church call and response. Rose says gospel and jazz share West African roots, but only New Orleans culture produced jazz.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
